pages.title: Benign Fluff
pages.text: Benign Fluff isn't tied to any race. It's one of the 16 songs in Skitchin's CD Player, all of them written by Jeff van Dyck. Between races, the menu gives you three choices: Next Race, Shop and CD Player.

pages.title: 16 tunes to choose from
pages.text: According to Mean Machines Sega, EA made "quite a big deal" of the 16 tunes you can choose from in Skitchin'. The magazine wasn't impressed, though, and pointed out that "the concept isn't exactly new."

pages.title: The graffiti artists
pages.text: To get the graffiti for Skitchin', the team photographed walls around Toronto and called a phone number they found on one of them. The painters, Carlos Zelaya, Zack Benwell and Nelson Garcia, were too young to drive, so they met the team at a train station.
